name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather in Buenos Aires. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, and landed his first job with a small touring car team. His meticulous attention to detail and innovative problem-solving quickly made him an invaluable asset. 

Before joining Cavaleiro Sports, Mateo honed his skills working for various teams in the Argentine TC2000 series. He believes that a strong technical director not only understands the car's mechanics inside and out but also fosters a collaborative environment where engineers can freely exchange ideas and challenge conventional thinking. Mateo is known for his dedication to optimizing every aspect of the car's performance, relentlessly pursuing marginal gains that can make a decisive difference on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Mateo has a focused gaze and a lean build, reflecting his dedication to his profession.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought
Refuses to start any work until he's had a strong cup of mate
